_comment: GPU variant overrides for template.json. Use with: packer build -var-file=omarchy-arch/gpu.vars.json omarchy-arch/template.json. Everything the GPU build needs to differ lives here, so the template itself has one shape and the expensive build is never what you get by accident.
_comment_region: GPU droplets are only offered in a subset of regions; nyc2 is the one paired with the nyc3 region the base image is built in. The base image must be transferred to nyc2 before this will find it.
_comment_size: Billed for the whole build, which is dominated by the model downloads rather than the provisioning. A real GPU is present so 050-nvidia.sh can verify with nvidia-smi, and the disk is what holds the models.
_comment_models: Set to an empty string to install Ollama and its service but download nothing, which keeps the snapshot near the standard ~7 GB and leaves users to `ollama pull` what they want. The default set is roughly 240 GB.
